meta.name: context-engineering
meta.description: Master context engineering for AI agent systems. Use when designing agent architectures, debugging context failures, optimizing token usage, implementing memory systems, building multi-agent coordination, evaluating agent performance, or developing LLM-powered pipelines. Covers context fundamentals, degradation patterns, optimization techniques (compaction, masking, caching), compression strategies, memory architectures, multi-agent patterns, LLM-as-Judge evaluation, tool design, and project development.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会学习如何用最少的 token 完成高质量推理。它会自动分析上下文健康度、检测退化、优化 token 使用，并支持跨会话记忆、多智能体协调等高级功能。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude learns to maximize reasoning quality while minimizing token usage. It analyzes context health, detects degradation, optimizes token utilization, and supports cross-session memory and multi-agent coordination.
howto.when_en: Activate when designing/debugging agent systems, facing context limits, optimizing cost/latency, building multi-agent coordination, or implementing memory systems.
